oneOf.description: A root: the frame of an imported image.

The two edge strips of a wrapped parent, side by side; the centre column is the
parent's wrap edge. Carries `parent`, `parent_identity` and `plan`.
An integer bbox of the parent. Carries `parent`, `parent_identity` and `bbox`.

Plan.description: The cut plan: how a `cut:` canvas was taken from its parent and how `put` returns it.

identity.description: `sha256:` over the parent frame's identity, width, height, strip and the spans.

left_span.description: The parent columns `[start, end)` the canvas's left half came from: the rightmost `s`.

right_span.description: The parent columns the canvas's right half came from: the leftmost `s`.

strip.description: The strip width: even, at least 2, `2s <= width`.

Projection.description: How an image's pixels map onto the world.

oneOf.description: A full 360 by 180 panorama whose left and right edges meet.

Topology.description: Whether the frame's horizontal edges meet.

oneOf.description: The left and right edges are the same column: a complete equirectangular frame.

description:
A frame record, as written to `frames.json`. The fields a kind needs are set; the others
are absent (`serde(flatten)` and `deny_unknown_fields` do not combine, so the derived
frames' fields are optional rather than a tagged union).

bbox.description: `[left, top, right, bottom)` in parent pixels, for a `crop:` frame.

identity.description:
`sha256:` over the kind, size, projection and topology, and for a derived frame its
parent's identity and the mapping parameters; no image is involved.

parent.description: The parent frame id, for a derived frame.

parent_identity.description: The parent's identity, for a derived frame.

plan.description: The cut plan, for a `cut:` frame.

title: Frame
